verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an official npm-installed CLI built for agents: `--json` output with schemaVersion/data on stdout and errors on stderr, `doctor`, `init` that writes skill files for Codex and Claude Code, and agent-drivable device-code login. Recorded hands-on probes confirm `--version`, `doctor`, `init --dry-run`, `auth login --json`, offline guides and schema validation all run as documented, with authenticated commands failing cleanly with structured AUTH_REQUIRED errors. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration (probes are self-recorded), and observed end-to-end use of the authenticated hosted process/context commands.
